transitions.operation_detail: Lysis in the sealed nanowell array and hybridisation of poly(A)+ mRNA to the bead oligo-dT; beads recovered and pooled.

Maxima H- RT, 30 min room temperature then 90 min at 52C; terminal transferase adds untemplated dC and the TSO is template-switched onto the cDNA 3' end. Washes folded in. Template switching does not always succeed; both the SMART-tailed and the untailed cDNA are carried forward.
Exonuclease I (37C, 50 min) removes unextended bead oligos; 0.1 M NaOH (5 min) denatures and removes the mRNA. Washes folded in.
dN-SMRT randomer anneals at random positions and is extended by Klenow exo- (37C, 1 h), appending the SMART handle to the second strand; failed-switching cDNAs are rescued here.
Single-primer semi-suppressive WTA with the SMART/ISPCR primer (KAPA HiFi; 4 cycles at 65C then 9-12 at 67C); SPRI purification and QC folded in.

Nextera XT tagmentation of about 1 ng cDNA (TD plus ATM, 55C, 5 min), neutralised with NT; Tn5 leaves a 9-bp gap. Fragments lacking the barcode end or carrying two s5 ends are not amplifiable and are not carried forward.
Library PCR with the P5-SMART hybrid oligo and the Nextera N7XX index oligo (NPM): 72C gap fill then 12 cycles at 95/55/72C; SPRI purification and QC folded in.
